levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Several foods are sorted into the wrong food group or left unsorted.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Nearly all foods from the day are sorted into a correct food group.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All foods are sorted correctly, including foods that reasonably belong to more than one group.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Cannot name which food group appeared least, or the suggested fix is not realistic for the meal named.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Correctly names the least-represented food group and proposes a realistic, specific food to close the gap.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names the gap, proposes a realistic fix, and explains why that specific meal is the easiest place to make the change.

lookFors: Foods listed in the warm-up are specific (named dishes or ingredients), not vague meal labels like 'breakfast.'
The reported food-group counts in the independent task match the sorting done in the guided task.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
